source.title: MetaZoo Tokens & NFTs
source.author: MetaZoo HQ
source.note: Fan-made reference page archived on the Wayback Machine. Per-cryptid mint counts total 875 Genesis 2021 NFTs; the article notes 596 visible on OpenSea at time of writing; our on-chain genesis_2021 fetch holds 595 tokens carrying only 6 distinct Alchemy-recovered cryptid names.

verification.method: Visually rendered candidate article GIFs and diffed against known on-chain Alchemy art for the same cryptid names (data/media/tokens/genesis_2021/), then confirmed with SHA-256 where a byte-identical copy existed.
findings: The brief's draft mapping had mzq_f98357b7ba4c2c51.gif assigned to Hodag, but it is visually identical (resized/recompressed: 512x512 vs the on-chain 640x640) to the on-chain MZG Bigfoot art d2213e32e3a8a543.gif. Reassigned to Bigfoot.

The brief's draft mapping had mzq_3dd2b2675970f2eb.gif assigned to Bigfoot, but its SHA-256 (de08706dba4e2911...) is byte-identical to the on-chain MZG Chupacabra art 1d2e70b1666a2994.gif. Reassigned to Chupacabra.

No article GIF was found depicting the true Hodag art (the green dragon/dinosaur-faced creature seen on-chain as 303b46b279b488d1.gif) -- the remaining unassigned article GIFs (mzq_0dbe8c09d60d1f29, mzq_12391c07ccd9dcde, mzq_416241fd0fee73d3, mzq_53b0c4fc6b30e06f, mzq_dfb9c2166bea567c, mzq_efdb86baed3aa5d7) are non-cryptid page decoration (gold/silver/bronze 1st-edition coin badges, a New Year's tournament banner, an egg illustration). Hodag's file is therefore null; the fill script falls back to same-cryptid art reuse from the manifest (99 other on-chain Hodag tokens already carry real art), so this has no practical impact on Task 6B's fill.
